messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 429 rate detected for tenant Kyron Corp (vpc-kyron-prod). 5m window: 17% 429s, spike beginning ~2103334300. Pager: Maya (oncall). Console: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/2103334445
Maya (oncall): saw alert, joining. Maya here — starting triage. Anyone owning kyron dedicated pool?
Alex (SRE): i'm on it, pulling metrics. initial glance: pool kyron-prod-pool-1 hit sustained qps spike ~21:07 UTC, queued requests climbed, token-bucket throttles triggered.
Cheng (runtime): FWIW there was a lightweight model rollout 21:06 UTC to kyron pool (v2.3.1). Deploy-bot posted the rollout. Could be load pattern change.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T21:06:34 -> kyron-dedicated v2.3.1 (canary 10% -> 100%). No immediate error rate on deploy markers.
Alex (SRE): logs show many 429s originating from per-tenant rate limiter error path: 
```
ERROR [ratelimiter] tenant=kyron tenant_allowed_tokens=500 tenant_inflight=1200 -> Reject 429
```
Queue depth on pool nodes ~800 requests. CPU on host group at 78%.
Maya (oncall): is this tenant capacity or global pool saturation?
Cheng (runtime): looks tenant-specific rate limiter hitting tenant window. The pool is near capacity but other tenants not impacted. Kyron has a high burst right now.
Sam (Support): I have Kyron SRE on call (tagged) — pinged them. Kyron-SRE, can you confirm any traffic spike on your side?
Kyron-SRE: Yep, we pushed a marketing campaign at 21:00 UTC, traffic to inference endpoints spiked. We're seeing retries from client side. Working on throttling client retries.
Liz (AcctOps): Heads up — Kyron is an enterprise VPC customer with reserved capacity but has a contractual burst clause. They may be eligible for emergency lift.
Maya (oncall): OK. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) apply emergency tenant quota lift for Kyron for 60m, 2) enable fallback routing to kyron-prod-pool-2 (other AZ), 3) ask Kyron to reduce retry behavior. Need authorizer for quota change.
Alex (SRE): I can apply temporary override. Proposed API call: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/admin/tenants/kyron/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"quota_tokens_per_min": 20000, "expires_at": "2026-03-15T22:06:00Z", "reason": "emergency-burst-lift"}'
```
I will not run until we have ack from AcctOps.
Liz (AcctOps): I approve provisional 24h exception for emergency mitigation. Put the change in the billing exceptions queue afterwards.
Alex (SRE): executing now.
Alex (SRE): override applied. Confirming: tenant quota -> 20000 tpm, expires 2026-03-15T22:06:00Z.
incident-bot: [CONFIG CHANGE] tenant override applied by Alex (SRE).
Cheng (runtime): I also flipped routing to kyron-prod-pool-2 and added graceful diversion to fallback nodes. Command: `route.set --tenant kyron --fallback pool=kyron-prod-pool-2 ratio=0.5`
Maya (oncall): metrics check please — 5m window after override.
Alex (SRE): 3m in: 429s down from 17% -> 4.2%. latency p50 stable, p95 improved slightly. Queue depth falling to ~120. CPU on primary pool back to 62%.
Kyron-SRE: seeing successful responses return to normal. We'll throttle client-side retries now to smooth. Thanks.
Ryan (PM): please log this as a customer-impact incident and notify customer-success with a short summary. They may want a formal incident brief.
Sam (Support): filing ticket CS-6142 with summary + timeline. I'll paste once created.
Sam (Support): CS-6142: Kyron VPC 429 surge — temporary quota override applied, traffic diversion, customer notified.
Maya (oncall): handoff notes for next oncall (Alex): monitor until override expires 22:06Z, if 429s reappear escalate to runtime-eng. Action items: 
- Alex: keep watch, extend override only with AcctOps approval.
- Cheng: schedule postmortem on root cause (deploy vs client pattern).
- Liz: follow up with Kyron on contract uplift / billing exception.
- Sam: include customer-visible summary and recommend retry-backoff guidance.
Alex (SRE): ack, will monitor. If traffic sustains, propose formal reserved capacity bump and quota rebaseline.
Cheng (runtime): quick diag notes for postmortem: capture model serving latency per-version, check kernel selection change at v2.3.1, sample KV cache hit-rate during spike. Use runbook: https://runbooks.internal/kyron-429-response
Kyron-SRE: Appreciate the fast response. We'll coordinate on a long-term plan (rate limiting, client exponential backoff).
Liz (AcctOps): I'll coordinate contract exception paperwork, expecting sign-off by EOD.
Maya (oncall): closing incident channel for active mitigation, leaving thread open for follow-ups. Handoff to Alex (SRE) as pager owner. :white_check_mark:
Alex (SRE): taking handoff. Ping me if anything changes.
Kyron-SRE: thanks everyone.
